notes: Scenarios 1-3 are the assignment's example requests verbatim (plus the languages the third one leaves open). 4 tests the ambiguous_topic stop with a real ambiguous term. 5 tests a refinement turn. Provider aborts (rate limits exhausted, daily quota, request-size limits) are reported as a status and excluded from the pass count; re-run those with --only.

turns: We are creating a language-learning application. Compare interest in learning English across Polish, Czech and Ukrainian Wikipedia and prepare a short PDF report: which audiences should we investigate next and why?
evals.expected_output: Resolution first lands on the low-volume Q2731224 concept (`Learning English — simplified English in Voice of America`); the model notices from label/description (and the low-volume warning) and re-runs with --qid Q1860, writes notes, runs report.py. It relays the computed comparison: Ukrainian has the highest relative attention (~124 per million, ~2.8x Polish) while all three decline; which audience to *recommend* is judgment and is not graded. It must not read demand or receptiveness off pageviews.
